meta.title: Jev planning
meta.description: Adds staged planning through the Jev judge. Three tools (jev_requirements, jev_plan_review, jev_consult) check the owner's request as individual requirements, review a written plan artifact outline by outline, section by section and as a final assembly, and answer one typed decision when a judgement should not rest on the model's guess. Once requirements are submitted, a gate holds consequential tool calls (write, edit, mutating bash, delegation, worktrees, plugin management) until the final plan is approved and bound to the artifact's exact bytes; read-only inspection and writes under the artifact directory stay allowed. The judge is called through the same provider chain as Jevstice: OpenCode Go, OpenCode, OpenRouter, then TypeSafe, using OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY (jev-1.13, not the free model), OPENCODE_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY or TYPESAFE_API_KEY (or the matching _API_KEY_COMMAND), or the same reference name in the DSH credential store. State is in memory per session, and /jev status reports the local stage without a judge call.
